job.title: [Post] Hiring: Salesforce Technical Lead – Commerce Cloud (SFCC + PWA Kit) ... Looking for candid…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Hiring: Salesforce Technical Lead – Commerce Cloud (SFCC + PWA Kit)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Technical Lead role at Prathyusha Dareddy. With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in backend architecture, headless commerce APIs, and complex platform integrations.

bullets.label: Headless & OCC APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for robust data flows.

bullets.label: PWA Integration
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC Web Services for Headless Commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized complex data pipelines and PIM-to-platform synchronizations using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Solution Delivery & Leadership
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production troubleshooting, and worked closely with international technical and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit requiring no sponsorship, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise e-commerce background aligns with your technical leadership needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to join Prathyusha Dareddy to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience in architecting scalable platforms, delivering headless APIs, and driving robust integrations. My background in building high-performance backend systems for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell positions me to bring immediate technical value and leadership to your commerce initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture, API development, and platform integration expertise to drive technical excellence at Prathyusha Dareddy.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience in enterprise e-commerce, headless APIs, and platform integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am currently serving my notice period (available from 16.12.2026) and would love to discuss your Technical Lead opening.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Technical Lead – Commerce Cloud – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Technical Lead – Commerce Cloud position. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms, headless APIs, and complex data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical expertise to your team.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
